comment: Numeric floor manifest (DR-27a). No pinned floor may decrease — tests/guards/numeric-floor-manifest.test.ts enforces this. New entries are allowed; increase an existing floor value when the corresponding assertion is raised.

floors.description: Number of compiled MDS host commands in dist/commands/ (ALL_HOSTS)
DIST_FILES count = ALL_HOSTS (13) + release.md (1); DIST_FILES vs ALL_HOSTS divergence is permanent (SG-13)
Minimum timeout in ms for slow shell-exec tests that call npm run build:mds
Minimum number of subagent_type literal sites across dist+scripts corpus (currently ~66+)
MAX_CHARTER_CHARS = 75% of the 4096-char shell injection cap; orchestrator charter must stay at or below this
Minimum number of DEVFLOW_PLUGINS registry entries
Minimum install-path references in dist/commands/ files
